mapper.sql: id, scenic_area_id, spot_id, rule_id, visit_date, start_time, end_time, total_capacity, reserved_count, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select from spot_reservation_slot where id = #{id} limit 1

select s.spot_id as spotId, max(sp.spot_name) as spotName, coalesce(sum(s.total_capacity), 0) as totalCapacity, coalesce(sum(s.reserved_count), 0) as reservedCount, greatest(coalesce(sum(s.total_capacity), 0) - coalesce(sum(s.reserved_count), 0), 0) as remainingCount, case when coalesce(sum(s.total_capacity), 0) = 0 then 0 else round(coalesce(sum(s.reserved_count), 0) * 100.0 / sum(s.total_capacity), 1) end as usageRate from spot_reservation_slot s left join scenic_spot sp on sp.id = s.spot_id and sp.deleted = 0 where s.visit_date = #{visitDate} and s.scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId} group by s.spot_id order by usageRate desc, reservedCount desc, s.spot_id asc

select s.start_time as startTime, s.end_time as endTime, concat(date_format(s.start_time, '%H:%i'), '-', date_format(s.end_time, '%H:%i')) as timeRange, coalesce(sum(s.reserved_count), 0) as visitorCount from spot_reservation_slot s where s.visit_date = #{visitDate} and s.scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId} group by s.start_time, s.end_time order by visitorCount desc, s.start_time asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update spot_reservation_slot set reserved_count = reserved_count + #{visitorCount}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 1 and reserved_count + #{visitorCount} <= total_capacity
